4lf__ie: Gideon Lfie came from Stoneyford, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

Gideon Lfie went over with the raiders and dropped into the Hegemony trench. Karel "Mole" Kieran was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@kim_jong_un_kieran) Gideon Lfie joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-F9. Gideon Lfie has learned to walk bent double.
bigpipguy: Marek Bigpipguy took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
A replacement turned out to be from Varenne too. Marek Bigpipguy and the newcomer argued about the same bakery for half the night.

Marek Bigpipguy is Lance Corporal now. At supper, a recruit waited for him to sit before taking a place. He noticed. The transfer made Marek Bigpipguy a runner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Marek Bigpipguy added a leak above the man's head in pencil. A letter from home reached Marek Bigpipguy before dusk. Marek Bigpipguy read it twice and slept a little easier.
Marek Bigpipguy spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.

Marek Bigpipguy jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Roland Zle. The Concord medics will be busy. (@yee.zle) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Marek Bigpipguy snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Marek Bigpipguy free. Marek Bigpipguy walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
ekwilks: Day 6. The corporal put Arno Ekwilks beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag saw Arno Ekwilks freeze up on the fire step at the Ossuary Wood. Mud said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough. A letter from home reached Arno Ekwilks before dusk. Arno Ekwilks read it twice and slept a little easier.

A muddy dog crawled into S-S11 through the wire. Arno Ekwilks gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Mercy. A letter from home reached Arno Ekwilks before dusk. Arno Ekwilks read it twice and slept a little easier.

Mercy has learned to carry messages in a tin on its collar. Arno Ekwilks is very proud. Mercy is mainly proud of the biscuits. A letter from home reached Arno Ekwilks before dusk. Arno Ekwilks read it twice and slept a little easier.

Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Arno Ekwilks stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. A letter from home reached Arno Ekwilks before dusk. Arno Ekwilks read it twice and slept a little easier.
forgacserik: Day 10: Valentin Forgacserik reached T-F9 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
hanka_b97: The new rifleman gave his name as Bastian "Owl" Hanka. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Bastian "Owl" Hanka was number 2. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.
A flare lit the Ossuary Wood like noon. Bastian "Owl" Hanka counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
Bastian "Owl" Hanka started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."

The relief reached S-F11 without Bastian "Owl" Hanka. His name was added to a list the corporal kept separate from the dead. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Bastian "Owl" Hanka stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Nobody at S-F11 has seen Bastian "Owl" Hanka since the last patrol. His bunk is still made.

Bastian "Owl" Hanka is still missing. The sergeant keeps his name on the roll and calls it out every morning anyway. At dusk Bastian "Owl" Hanka walked back into S-F11, covered in mud, and asked for a place on the wiring party. The sergeant crossed the name off the missing list.

Wiring party. Bastian "Owl" Hanka held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at S-F11, and everyone came back. The Hegemony took Hill 304, and the orders at S-F11 changed before the cheering ended. Bastian "Owl" Hanka shouldered another load.
Bastian "Owl" Hanka's diary, day nine: "Still here. Soup again. A rat called the Major. Nothing else worth writing, which is the point."
Bastian "Owl" Hanka washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
Bastian "Owl" Hanka read his diary from the start tonight and laughed at how frightened he was back then. Then he stopped laughing and wrote: "Still here."

Bastian "Owl" Hanka felt a hard tug at his hip at S-F11. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Oskar Pearson of the Concord (@_william.pearson_).

Bastian "Owl" Hanka rejoined the squad at S-F11. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Bastian "Owl" Hanka folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
jakegriffal: Dietrich Jakegriffal walked into P-F13 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In P-F13, Dietrich Jakegriffal listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
liamlove447: Wendel Liamlove was a farmhand in Rosenau until the posters went up. He came to T-F21 with a stub of a pencil, and within a day the whole squad knew that he never takes off his scarf.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Wendel Liamlove stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
maccerny808: Nobody saw Roland Maccerny arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-F4, and a quiet rifleman under it.
Roland Maccerny wrote a letter for Lucien "Shadow" Jro's mother, because Shadow could not find the words. Shadow signed it.

Roland Maccerny found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Roland Maccerny looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A parcel from home held a comb. Roland Maccerny has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
Roland Maccerny saw a hare run the whole length of no man's land and nobody on either side fired at it.

Roland Maccerny raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F4. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Albin Travismac of the Hegemony (@travismac78). Roland Maccerny fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-F4. Silas Hansen was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Roland Maccerny rejoined the squad at S-F4. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Roland Maccerny kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
markusapina: On the way to R-C6, Lucien Markusapina tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Lucien Markusapina shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
mng.ngaihte: The quartermaster asked Benedikt Ngaihte to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.

A clear shot from R-F7. Benedikt Ngaihte grazed Jonas Steini and slid back down below the parapet. The report confirmed that the Concord held Verdel Ridge. Benedikt Ngaihte read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Benedikt Ngaihte kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.

Benedikt Ngaihte opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first. A letter from home found Benedikt Ngaihte before the night shift. Benedikt Ngaihte folded it small and kept it close.

The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Benedikt Ngaihte offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once. A letter from home found Benedikt Ngaihte before the night shift. Benedikt Ngaihte folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Benedikt Ngaihte did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Benedikt Ngaihte fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Edmund Crack, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. A letter from home found Benedikt Ngaihte before the night shift. Benedikt Ngaihte folded it small and kept it close.
A parcel came for Benedikt Ngaihte that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: two knitted scarves. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.

The parcel's address was smudged. Benedikt Ngaihte took it to the clerk, who found two possible units and no reason to hurry. A letter from home found Benedikt Ngaihte before the night shift. Benedikt Ngaihte folded it small and kept it close.
Benedikt Ngaihte caught a supply driver heading for one of the units and handed the parcel over with a note asking for word when it arrived.

Benedikt Ngaihte saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-F7 and fired once. Teodor "Button" Magtyu was grazed. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Benedikt Ngaihte helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
